At least 10 years' experience managing complex health or development programmes. A proven track record in donor engagement and proposal development. Experience representing organisations in global and policy forums, including with the UN, governments, and donor roundtables. Knowledge of policy frameworks, sector standards, and practices in at least one of the three IHI health areas. Proven experience in project cycle management, monitoring and evaluation (M&E), and budgeting. Strong partnership management, coordination, team leadership, communication, problem-solving, and organisational skills. Ability to work independently and collaboratively in multicultural settings. review_candidates.description: Job Role: Gardinia Contracting, the fully integrated construction powerhouse behind Azizi Developments, is at the forefront of some of Dubai’s most ambitious real estate ventures. Our team is responsible for delivering iconic projects such as Burj Azizi, poised to become the world’s second tallest tower, and the expansive Azizi Venice master community in Dubai South. From civil works and MEP to interior fitouts, landscaping, and pools, we manage every detail in-house through a hands-on, quality-first approach. Gardinia is rapidly scaling to support a growing portfolio of luxury residential, commercial, and hospitality developments. If you are ready to be part of the team shaping Dubai’s skyline, your future starts here. Construction Manager is responsible for overseeing the construction process for buildings. Their duties include upholding the use of quality materials and procedures, adhering to budgets to complete tasks or purchase materials and reviewing contracts to make sure that current practices align with the owner’s expectations. Responsibilities: The Project Director will be responsible for the overall leadership, management, and successful delivery of a super high-rise construction project in the UAE. This senior role involves overseeing all phases of the project, including planning, execution, monitoring, and closing, while ensuring alignment with the client's vision, budget, timeline, quality standards, and regulatory requirements. The Project Director will lead and coordinate multiple teams, stakeholders, contractors, and consultants, ensuring the project progresses efficiently and meets its strategic objectives. Key Responsibilities: Project Leadership & Strategy: Lead the project from inception to completion, ensuring the project's objectives, including quality, scope, budget, and timelines, are met. Define the project vision, goals, and key performance indicators (KPIs), and ensure alignment with the client’s strategic objectives. Develop and implement a comprehensive project management plan outlining key deliverables, milestones, timelines, and resource requirements. Maintain regular communication with clients, stakeholders, and senior management to ensure alignment on key decisions and provide project status updates. Ensure strong coordination between internal and external stakeholders, including design teams, contractors, subcontractors, consultants, and regulatory authorities. Project Planning & Scheduling: Develop detailed project plans that define clear objectives, tasks, and milestones for each phase of construction. Collaborate with the Planning Manager to ensure that the project schedule is aligned with overall project goals and that all deadlines are met. Proactively identify potential project delays or risks and implement effective mitigation strategies to maintain the schedule. Oversee the establishment of timelines for construction, procurement, and commissioning, ensuring efficient and seamless coordination across all stages. Budget & Financial Management: Develop and manage the project budget, ensuring all costs are accounted for and that the project is delivered within financial parameters. Monitor and control project costs, ensuring timely payments, cost-effective procurement of materials, and proper contract management. Approve cost variations, change orders, and invoices, ensuring that any deviations from the budget are documented and justified. Collaborate with the Finance Manager to ensure financial risks are minimized and the project remains profitable. Provide regular financial reports to senior leadership, including cost analysis, projected expenditure, and any financial risks. Risk Management & Quality Control: Develop and implement a comprehensive risk management plan, identifying and assessing potential risks to the project’s schedule, budget, quality, and safety. Manage risks related to construction delays, regulatory changes, resource allocation, and external factors. Monitor the quality assurance and quality control processes to ensure that construction work meets the required specifications and standards. Ensure compliance with all local and international construction standards, including safety regulations, building codes, and environmental guidelines. Conduct regular audits and inspections to ensure adherence to quality and safety protocols. Team Management & Coordination: Lead and mentor the project management team, including site engineers, planners, procurement specialists, and other key personnel. Develop a positive work environment, fostering teamwork, collaboration, and high performance among all project staff. Ensure that all team members have the necessary resources, training, and support to successfully execute their responsibilities. Conduct regular meetings with the project team to review progress, discuss challenges, and align on solutions. Contract Management & Procurement: Oversee the contract negotiation and procurement process, ensuring all contracts are clear, fair, and in line with the project’s scope and budget. Work closely with procurement teams to ensure that materials, equipment, and services are available on schedule, at the right cost, and with the required quality. Ensure compliance with all terms and conditions in subcontracts, purchase orders, and vendor agreements. Resolve disputes with contractors or suppliers in a timely manner, ensuring minimal disruption to project timelines. Stakeholder & Client Relationship Management: Act as the primary point of contact for the client and ensure that their expectations are consistently met or exceeded. Manage relationships with regulatory authorities, ensuring all necessary permits and approvals are obtained on time. Prepare and deliver client presentations, reports, and updates to communicate project progress, risks, and milestones. Address client concerns and escalate issues when necessary, maintaining a proactive and solutions-oriented approach. Health, Safety, and Environmental Compliance: Ensure the implementation of the Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) standards across all phases of the project. Promote a strong safety culture on-site, ensuring that all personnel follow safety protocols and regulations. Coordinate with HSE officers to regularly monitor and enforce safety standards, ensuring zero accidents or injuries. Manage the implementation of sustainable construction practices, ensuring compliance with local environmental regulations and achieving green building certifications when applicable. Project Reporting & Documentation: Ensure timely, accurate, and comprehensive project reporting, including progress reports, budgets, schedule updates, and risk management logs. Maintain proper project documentation for all activities, including contracts, approvals, inspection reports, and compliance certificates. Provide regular project updates to senior management, highlighting key milestones, challenges, and solutions. Maintain post-project documentation for future reference and lessons learned for continuous improvement. Technical Skills: Expertise in project management software such as Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, and Procore. Extensive knowledge of construction methodologies, scheduling techniques, and contract law. Proficiency in budget management, cost control, and risk management strategies. In-depth understanding of local construction codes, regulations, and safety standards. Requirement: Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field. A Master’s degree in Project Management, Construction Engineering, or an MBA is highly desirable. Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent is required. LEED or BREEAM accreditation is an advantage for sustainability-driven projects. 15-20+ years of experience in the construction industry, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role managing large-scale, high-rise construction projects. Proven experience in overseeing complex super high-rise construction projects (e.g., skyscrapers, mega developments, mixed-use buildings). Strong background in managing multi milliondollar budgets, multiple stakeholders, and large project teams. Previous experience working in the UAE construction market or other Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) countries is highly preferred.

review_candidates.title: Partnerships Manager
review_candidates.job_function: Consulting, Project Management, and General Business
review_candidates.description: Senior Associate (Partnerships Manager) — Global Supply Partnership You don't just "manage" partners. You build the supply engine that powers a global AI platform. Joveo's recruitment advertising platform runs on machine learning, real-time bidding, and predictive optimization — delivering millions of job ads to the right candidates at the right moment. But none of that works without world-class supply partnerships fueling the machine. That's where you come in. The Role — In Plain English You'll own relationships that directly impact revenue, reach, and platform performance across global markets. This isn't account management with a fancier title. You're the person who spots an untapped supply channel in Southeast Asia on Tuesday, negotiates the commercial terms by Thursday, and has it live and delivering candidates the following week. Your week might look like this: Monday: Analyze partner performance data. One channel is underpacing — you diagnose why and fix it before anyone escalates. Tuesday: Jump on a call with a new publisher. Pitch the partnership. Negotiate terms that work for both sides. Wednesday: Sit with Product and Tech to unblock an integration that's been stalling a high-value partner launch. Thursday: Build an automation workflow that eliminates 4 hours of manual reporting your team does every week. Friday: Present your partner growth roadmap to the CXO. Get buy-in. Start executing. You'll talk to partners in the morning, negotiate contracts before lunch, dig into performance dashboards after, and pitch process improvements to leadership by end of day — all in the same role. What Makes This Different Most partnership roles at this level put you in a box — either "relationship manager" or "operations associate." This one refuses to separate the two. You'll own the full lifecycle: find the partner, close the deal, launch the integration, track the numbers, optimize the outcome. End to end. No handoffs to five other teams. Direct access to CXOs and senior leadership. Real commercial ownership from day one. And you're building systems that scale — not just doing the work, but redesigning how the work gets done. You Might Be Right For This If... You have 2+ years in partnerships, supply ops, business operations, or client-facing roles — ideally in SaaS, Ad Tech, HR Tech, or recruitment advertising You've actually negotiated a deal, not just "supported" one. You know what it feels like to own a number. You're the person who looks at a messy spreadsheet and sees a pattern everyone else missed You can context-switch between a partner call, a data pull, and a strategy doc without losing momentum Process inefficiency physically bothers you. You automate things before anyone asks you to. You're comfortable in ambiguity — startup speed doesn't stress you, it sharpens you What You'll Get Real ownership: Commercial decisions, partner relationships, and operational outcomes — yours from day one Leadership exposure: Work directly with CXOs and cross-functional leads across Product, Tech, Sales, and Client Success Growth trajectory: Previous hires in this function have built entirely new capabilities within Joveo's supply ecosystem Compensation: Among the most competitive in India, including stock options Global scope: Partners and markets that span continents — not a single-geography desk job If you'd rather build the partnership playbook than follow one — we should talk. Joveo. Where AI meets the future of work.

You will be invited to celebrate community events such as sports days, fun-runs, in-house sports teams and beach clean ups. In addition to your competitive package and benefits you will have access to a suite of policies that include hybrid working arrangements, individual athletic sponsorship, study assistance sponsorship, employee referral rewards. Responsibilities Our newest opportunity is for a talented MEP Inspector to join our team based in Dubai, UAE. The MEP Inspector will be responsible for providing on-site supervision and technical support for all MEP engineering aspects of the project. This includes ensuring compliance with all relevant codes, standards, and contract specifications. We envisage success in this role to include; Overseeing the design, coordination, and implementation of Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) systems for construction projects. Ensuring compliance with all applicable local codes, standards, regulations, and project specifications in the country where the project is located. Reviewing and approving MEP shop drawings, material submittals, and technical documents submitted by contractors and subcontractors to ensure compliance with project requirements and quality standards. Conducting regular site inspections to monitor the progress of MEP works and ensuring adherence to approved drawings, specifications, project schedules, and safety standards. Inspecting and testing MEP installations at various stages of construction to verify functionality, quality, and compliance with design intent. Investigating and resolving MEP-related issues, clashes, or defects arising during construction, while coordinating with contractors, consultants, and other stakeholders to implement corrective actions. Preparing and maintaining detailed records of MEP inspections, testing results, approvals, and non-conformance reports for quality assurance and project documentation purposes. Ensuring all MEP activities on site are being executed safely by implementing and enforcing safety procedures, conducting safety inspections, and addressing potential hazards promptly. We embrace diversity and recognise its’ contribution to client success wherever we work. We are excited to hear how you can partner with our award-winning team and treat all expressions of interest confidentially.
